key.name: focus-left
key.summary: Focus the column to the left

key.name: focus-right
key.summary: Focus the column to the right

key.name: focus-up
key.summary: Focus the window above in the column

key.name: focus-down
key.summary: Focus the window below in the column

key.name: move-up
key.summary: Move the window up within its column

key.name: move-down
key.summary: Move the window down within its column

key.name: cycle-width
key.summary: Cycle the column width through 1/3, 1/2 and 2/3

key.name: toggle-full
key.summary: Toggle the column at full width

key.name: slurp
key.summary: Pull the next column's top window into this column

key.name: barf
key.summary: Push the focused window out into its own column

key.name: toggle-float
key.summary: Toggle floating for the focused window
